item.title: Six deaths in Texas ICE centers prompt urgent investigation
item.description: Six people have died while detained by ICE in Texas in six weeks, with the second fatality at the Fort Bliss Army tent structure ruled a homicide, prompting renewed scrutiny of conditions at the facility and other ICE detention sites, while the Biden administration is seeking to open additional ICE facilities in Texas and across the country despite growing resistance from state and local leaders.

item.title: United States wins Olympic gold medal in women's hockey, defeating Canada 2-1
item.description: United States wins its third Olympic gold medal in women's hockey, beating Canada 2-1 on Megan Keller's goal in overtime.

item.title: Former Prince Andrew arrested, held for hours on suspicion of misconduct in public office
item.description: Mountbatten-Windsor, who turned 66 on Thursday, moved to his brother King Charles III’s estate in Norfolk after he was evicted from his longtime home near Windsor Castle earlier this month.

item.title: Constable searching for 2 men caught illegally dumping trash in north Houston
item.description: Two men were spotted illegally dumping trash onto the side of a road in north Houston, authorities said.

item.title: 'Forum Park Crips' gang member gets long federal prison sentence for sex trafficking
item.description: In handing down the prison terms, U.S. District Judge George C. Hanks Jr. said that McGee’s conduct was “horrific” and that McGee was “every parent’s worst nightmare.”

item.title: New stretch of Kinder Trail opens along Buffalo Bayou East
item.description: Discover the new stretch of the Kinder Trail by Buffalo Bayou Partnership, connecting neighborhoods and adding green space in Houston's Buffalo Bayou East.

item.title: Alysa Liu wins first women's figure skating gold medal for the US in 24 years
item.description: Alysa Liu delivered the U.S. its first women’s figure skating Olympic gold medal in 24 years, performing a near-flawless free skate on Thursday night in a glittering golden dress to upstage Japanese rivals Kaori Sakamoto and Ami Nakai at the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: 'You are innocent': Judge signs orders formally clearing former suspects in Austin yogurt shop murders
item.description: After spending decades of their lives wrongly accused of one of Austin's most infamous crimes, four men previously believed to have killed four teenage girls at the I Can’t Believe It’s Yogurt! shop on Anderson Lane in 1991 will finally see their names cleared.

item.title: Springlike weather before a front dries us out this weekend
item.description: Dry skies will start early in the morning and continue all day.

item.title: Hitchcock mayor arrested for involvement in illegal gambling sting in Galveston County
item.description: Hitchcock mayor Chris Armacost was charged with engaging in in organized criminal activity, according to the Galveston County Sheriff's Office.
